validation_gates.reason: The path filter starts this workflow for any genrec-source-probe-envelope-* or genrec-source-and-trust-projection-profiles-* receipt, but the receipt step validates only the receipts it names, so a later successor added without updating the step would pass unchecked (review finding on #5294). The step now fails when a matching receipt is not named in the workflow; with an unnamed receipt present it exits 1 with an ::error:: line. It also pins genrec-source-probe-envelope-receipt-binding-20261019 to 8c4b8da938798f00bdf503f9819530df7a8a64e0, the merge of #5294, and validates this successor against the current bytes.

All four receipt invocations and the coverage guard pass as written; both fixture replays and the focused tests pass. make repository-guardrails PASS, including workflow security; tests/ci, the receipt-validator tests and the guardrail attribution tests pass.

validation_gates.gate: Hosted CI on the pushed head

notes: Earlier receipts are unchanged and each is validated at the commit where its bytes were recorded. A later change to the workflow, validator or test adds a successor receipt, pins this one to the commit that merges it, and names the successor in the step; the coverage guard fails the job until it does.
